object.attr: analysis: an export takes about 100 s at 1,000 objects, longer than common client timeouts, so the agent sees a failure while the PDF is written later, and a retry meets MELLON-PDF-SRS-32. Decided on 2026-11-11 (review Q12); the general contract for long calls is handed to MCP.
object.description: While the MCP server's export tool runs, the MCP server should send the agent the progress notifications that the Model Context Protocol defines.
